patthana21.52:1.1: Nasārammaṇaṃ nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anārammaṇo sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Ekaṃ.
patthana21.52:2.1: Naanārammaṇaṃ nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anārammaṇo sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Ekaṃ. Gaṇitakena tīṇi.
patthana21.52:4.1: Nasārammaṇaṃ naanidassanaappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anārammaṇo anidassanaappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana21.52:5.1: Nocittaṃ nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocitto sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Ekaṃ.
patthana21.52:6.1: Nanocittaṃ nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocitto sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Ekaṃ. Gaṇitakena
patthana21.52:8.1: Nacetasikaṃ nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nacetasiko sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā…
patthana21.52:10.1: Nacittasampayuttaṃ nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittavippayutto sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā…
patthana21.52:12.1: Nacittasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittavisaṃsaṭṭho sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā…
patthana21.52:14.1: Nocittasamuṭṭhānaṃ nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca cittasamuṭṭhāno sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Cittasamuṭṭhānarūpeneva tīṇi, saṃkhittaṃ.)
patthana21.52:16.1: Nocittasahabhuṃ nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasahabhū sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā…
patthana21.52:18.1: Nocittānuparivattiṃ nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittānuparivattī sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā…
patthana21.52:20.1: Nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhāno sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā…
patthana21.52:22.1: Nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuṃ nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhū sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā…
patthana21.52:24.1: Nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattiṃ nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nocittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattī sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā…
patthana21.52:26.1: Naajjhattikaṃ nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bāhiro sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Ekaṃ.
patthana21.52:27.1: Nabāhiraṃ nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca bāhiro sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Ekaṃ. Gaṇitakena
patthana21.52:29.1: Noupādā nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca upādā sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
patthana21.52:31.1: Naupādinnaṃ nasanidassanasappaṭighaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anupādinno sanidassanasappaṭigho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā…
